# axiom_role (Resource)

Manages a custom role. A role grants capabilities on individual datasets and views, and across the organization. Assign a role to users with `axiom_group`, or set it as a user's base role with `axiom_user_role`. Requires the RBAC add-on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A role that can only query two datasets.
resource "axiom_role" "team_a_readers" {
  name        = "team-a-readers"
  description = "Query team A datasets"

  dataset_capabilities = {
    "team-a-logs"   = { query = ["read"] }
    "team-a-traces" = { query = ["read"] }
  }

  org_capabilities = {
    dashboards = ["read"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Must be unique in the organization and must not start with `axiom-`.

### Optional

- `dataset_capabilities` (Attributes Map) Capabilities on individual datasets, keyed by dataset name. The key `*` applies to all datasets. Each entry must have at least one capability. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataset_capabilities))
- `description` (String) Role description
- `org_capabilities` (Attributes) Organization-wide capabilities (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--org_capabilities))
- `view_capabilities` (Attributes Map) Capabilities on individual views, keyed by view name. Each entry must have at least one capability. The wildcard `*` isn't allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--view_capabilities))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role identifier
- `members` (Set of String) IDs of the users whose base role is this role. Users who receive the role through a group aren't included. Change a user's base role with `axiom_user_role`.

<a id="nestedatt--dataset_capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataset_capabilities`

Optional:

- `ingest` (Set of String) Ingest data into the dataset. Allowed actions: `create`.
- `query` (Set of String) Query the dataset. Allowed actions: `read`.
- `share` (Set of String) Share the dataset. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `delete`.
- `starred_queries` (Set of String) Manage starred queries of the dataset. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `trim` (Set of String) Trim the data in the dataset. Allowed actions: `update`.
- `vacuum` (Set of String) Vacuum the fields of the dataset. Allowed actions: `update`.
- `virtual_fields` (Set of String) Manage virtual fields of the dataset. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.


<a id="nestedatt--org_capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `org_capabilities`

Optional:

- `annotations` (Set of String) Manage annotations. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `api_tokens` (Set of String) Manage API tokens. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `audit_log` (Set of String) Read the audit log. Allowed actions: `read`.
- `billing` (Set of String) Manage billing. Allowed actions: `read`, `update`.
- `dashboards` (Set of String) Manage dashboards. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `datasets` (Set of String) Manage all datasets. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `endpoints` (Set of String) Manage endpoints. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `integrations` (Set of String) Manage integrations. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `labels` (Set of String) Manage labels. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `monitors` (Set of String) Manage monitors. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `notifiers` (Set of String) Manage notifiers. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `rbac` (Set of String) Manage roles and groups. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `shared_access_keys` (Set of String) Manage shared access keys. Allowed actions: `read`, `update`.
- `users` (Set of String) Manage users. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.
- `views` (Set of String) Manage views. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`.


<a id="nestedatt--view_capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `view_capabilities`

Optional:

- `query` (Set of String) Query the view. Allowed actions: `read`.
- `share` (Set of String) Share the view. Allowed actions: `create`, `read`, `delete`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import axiom_role.team_a_readers <role-id>
```
